description: Source code for cwmp_plugin_common.c, implementing functions related to fault message handling, bus context retrieval, and subscription management in a CWMP plugin.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_getFaultString
methods.description: Returns fault string corresponding to a fault code.

methods.name: get_bus_ctx
methods.description: Retrieves bus context based on a given path.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_add_subscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a given path and filter with a callback.

methods.name: cwmp_plugin_del_subscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription for a given path and callback.
